title: 30A Hideaway Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutNeed a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 30% Discount off Spring Rates! 4-night minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to May 22nd. Discount is reflected in online pricing. 20% Discount off Summer 2026! 4-nt minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to August 9th! Discount is reflected in online pricing. 30A Hideaway is a true departure from your typical 30A experience. Located in "The Hammocks", a private community off Hwy 395, you'll be nestled among oaks and magnolias. A large screened-in back porch offers a comfortable seat with nature views, perfect for relaxing after a day at the beach or a day shopping in the local 30A boutiques. The tranquility continues inside with a spacious open floor plan on the first level including a large living area, and a beautifully equipped kitchen and dining area. Comfortably sleeping 8 guests, each bedroom has its own private bathroom! The first floor King Master suite has a luxurious bathroom with a large soaking tub in a beautifully tiled shower. This home has the ideal layout for one or two families to join in the main living areas, but you still have your own private bedroom and bath to yourself. Pets are NOT allowed in 30A Hideaway. ABOUT THE AREA: The Hammocks at Seagrove is a tranquil and quaint Seagrove Beach community, hidden in between Old Seagrove Beach and WaterColor. If you're looking for a secluded place to have an intermission in your busy lifestyle for an unforgettable vacation, The Hammocks at Seagrove is the first place to look. All homes in this community are created with modern, chic touches in similarity to that of the WaterColor community. The community offers two pools plus a nature trail which leads to a small dock and creek that flows into Western Lake. Should you want to leave your woodland nest, a short walk or bike ride will take you to many of the area's most popular destinations, including the closest Seagrove Beach public access, only 0.5 mile from the home. You're also centrally located to explore the neighboring communities of Seaside, WaterColor, and Grayton Beach. BEACH ACCESS: The 395 Scenic Beach Access, located along Florida's beautiful 30A, is a peaceful getaway offering easy access to the Gulf of Mexico's emerald waters. This charming spot is nestled between coastal dunes and lush vegetation, with a wooden boardwalk leading you to soft, white sand beaches and gentle waves. For added convenience, the nearby Santa Clara Beach Access at 5311 E. County Hwy 30A provides restrooms and ample parking, making it an ideal spot for families and beachgoers. With stunning views, clear waters, and a tranquil atmosphere, the 395 and Santa Clara Beach Access areas offer the perfect coastal retreat. Main Level: 1 Bedroom. 1 Bath. Powder Room. Kitchen. Dining Table seats up to 4. Kitchen island seats 4. Laundry Room. Back Screened Porch. Front Porch #1 En-Suite Master King Bedroom, shower, soaking tub, pack-n-play. Second Level: 3 Bedrooms. 3 Full Baths. #2 En-Suite King Bedroom. #3 En-Suite Queen Bedroom. #4 En-Suite Twin Bedroom (2 XL). Amenities: Business Features Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 5 Roku Smart TV’s (no local cable, guests may use personal login credentials for streaming) Distinctive Features Gated community (no thru traffic) 2 private neighborhood pools Bed, bath, and kitchen linens provided (no beach towels) Beach Gear Credit General Features Parking for 2 vehicles 2 King beds, 1 Queen bed, 2 XL Twin beds Pack-n-Play (#1 Bedroom closet) 4 Full bathrooms, powder room, iron, ironing board, hair dryers, outdoor gas grill w/grill utensils, screened outdoor porch, porch furniture. Outdoor security camera facing driveway. Linens and bath towels provided. No Smoking. No Pets. *Please note the home next door is currently under construction. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen, Keurig + drip coffee maker, glass top electric induction range, refrigerator with ice maker, microwave, dishwasher, toaster, washer, dryer. Area Features Timpoochee Trail (30A bike path)Grayton Beach (3 miles)Seaside (1 mile)State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
